en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large town market square with rows of historic multi‑story buildings along one side. At left is a town hall–like building with a clock and an onion‑shaped dome tower. The open square is filled with carts, vendors' stalls, people walking, and a central fountain and lamp post. Low hills rise in the distance. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the market in Leitmeritz.
